label: British English
target_guidance: Use natural British English with consistent British spelling, vocabulary and punctuation. Preserve ${genre_voice_focus}.
punctuation_rule: Use consistent British English spelling, punctuation and spacing across the whole book: keep one steady quotation-mark style with standard comma speech tags (e.g. said, '...' or said, "...", never said: "..."), use proper dashes rather than raw double hyphens (--), and never leave raw source-script characters or parenthetical inline glosses inside narrative prose or verse. Format multi-clause poems, lyrics and verse couplets with explicit line breaks (\n) rather than inline prose or ' / ', and NEVER insert line breaks between dialogue turns inside a continuous prose paragraph. Preserve the structure and pairing of quotation marks, brackets, dashes, ellipses and special symbols.
